items.label: Organized Shoe Storage
items.value: This shoe rack restores order to your home with five shelves (including the top shelf) holding 16-20 pairs of shoes(depends on shoe size and type), ensuring a tidy display of your footwear and banishing chaos from corners

items.label: Collision of Black and Brown
items.value: Matte black frame is smooth and exquisite while the retro brown finish is noble and delicate, making this shoe organizer a perfect match to your home decorations and a charming spot for your family and friends

items.label: Flexible Tilting and Leveling
items.value: Besides a spacious top, this shoe rack has metal mesh shelves to be tilted or leveled as per your preference, catering to diverse storage needs. How to store heels or tall boots? Removable design helps you

items.label: Solid, Stable, Safe
items.value: This shoe rack is constructed of premium particleboard and metal mesh shelves. The top loads up to 44 lb and each mesh bears up to 22 lb, so you can enjoy safe use of this shoe rack. Of course you can expect long serviceability because the frame is hard to bent and age

items.label: No Hassle Assembly
items.value: We pay special attention to the customer’s product experience, including assembly experience. So we specially improved the assemble method and procedures of the product

items.label: Room Type
items.value: Bedroom, Closet, Garage, Hallway, Living Room

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: The product requires assembly. Detailed instructions and accompanying installation tools are included for easy setup.
